label: Jacobus Bothniensis
note: Q141283774. Geni records him only as `Jakob`; his son is `Nicolaus Jacobi Bothniensis`, whose `Jacobi` is the Latin genitive patronymic and whose `Bothniensis` is the toponymic, so the father is Jacobus Bothniensis. Her words: "Name should be ... Jacobus Bothniensis".
